title: "MLP Project Guidelines"
---

## Course Overview

The MLP Project is a rigorous, hands-on classical machine learning course centered around a Kaggle competition. It requires students to build an end-to-end ML pipeline from exploratory data analysis and preprocessing to feature engineering and model tuning using classical ML libraries. 

This website serves as the central handbook for the project. It outlines the deadlines, mandatory milestones, evaluation formulas, and the two-stage Viva examination process required to successfully complete the course. 

---

## Website Navigation Guide

The following is a breakdown of the pages on this website and what you will find on each to help you navigate effectively:

### Guidelines
This is the most comprehensive page on the site. It covers the fundamental rules of the project, including:

* **Workflow & Dates:** Key competition dates and deadlines.
* **Evaluation Formula:** The exact breakdown of the 100-mark grading system 
* **Rules & Allowed Libraries:** A strict whitelist of permitted tools (e.g., Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas) and a blacklist of forbidden tools (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, NLTK).

### Essentials
A strict "Do's and Don'ts" reference sheet designed to help you avoid immediate failure.

* **The Checklist:** Summarizes the absolute minimum requirements to pass (registration, 2/5 milestones, crossing the Kaggle cut-off, notebook readiness, and clearing both Vivas).
* **Grounds for Invalidation:** Outlines exactly what will get your project discarded, such as plagiarism, making your notebook public, direct `.csv` uploads instead of notebook execution, or using unauthorized external data.

### Milestones
This page details how to handle the 5 sequential checkpoints required throughout the project.

* **Naming Conventions:** Provides the exact file naming format (`[roll-number]_26t3_M[Milestone-Number].pdf`) required to avoid automated grading errors.
* **Timeline:** Lists the deadlines for all 5 milestones. 

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
A collection of common queries and their answers

### Resources
Any relevant links, images, and resources that will assist you in the completion of the project will be added here.
